department: School of Sustainable Engineering and the Built Environment

deadline.value: Priority deadline January 1, 2027 for fall (spring: July 1); review starts on the priority date.
deadline.quote: PhD: January 1 for fall semester admissions and July 1 for spring semester admissions.

gre_general.value: GRE is required for all SSEBE PhD programs, with minimum Quant 155 and Quant+Verbal 301; higher scores needed for funding.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are required for all SSEBE PhD programs. | minimum score in the Quantitative section is 700 (GRE General Test) or 155 (GRE revised General Test)

gre_subject.value: Engineering has no GRE Subject test; nothing stated.

supervisor.value: Faculty sponsorship is necessary for admission, so contact faculty in your specialty before applying.
supervisor.quote: Note that faculty sponsorship is necessary for admission. All prospective applicants should get in touch with one or more faculty working in their area of specialization

funding.value: TA/RA positions go to the most competitive applicants (priority to PhD students); only a limited number get written funding offers before entry.
funding.quote: RA/TA positions will be awarded to the most competitive applicants.

also.quote: A limited number of students receive written offers of financial aid prior to entering the program.

entry_route.value: A master's in engineering or a related field is normally required; exceptionally qualified bachelor's graduates may be admitted directly.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are eligible to apply to the program if they have earned a master's degree in engineering or a closely related master's degree program from a regionally accredited institution. Exceptionally qualified students with a bachelor's degree may be admitted to the doctoral program.

notes: Minimum GPA 3.20. TA applicants need TOEFL speaking 26 or SPEAK 55. Includes environmental engineering specialty.
name: Civil, Environmental and Sustainable Engineering PhD
